data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fahi' meaning 'to open', Fazia signifies 'she who illuminates', 'enlightened one', or 'bright one'. The name Fazia carries the meaning “Bright, Luminous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fazia usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, luminous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
